text: What best describes the composition of the PURE cell-free translation system?
choices: Crude E. coli lysate with endogenous mRNA depleted by a run-off reaction
A fully reconstituted system assembled from individually purified components: ribosomes, aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases, translation factors, tRNAs, and RNA polymerase
Only ribosomes and mRNA, relying on residual native polymerase activity
Lyophilized whole cells that are rehydrated with a patient sample
explanation: PURE is built entirely from individually purified components rather than crude lysate, which is exactly what makes it 'completely defined' with no unknown background components. Option 0 describes an extract-based system, not PURE; option 2 omits nearly all of PURE's required machinery; and option 3 describes a diagnostic paper-based application concept, not the PURE system's actual composition.
